Evening classes, twice weekly

Slow flow on Tuesdays, restorative on Thursdays.

Doors open thirty minutes early so you can settle onto your mat.

Mats and props are provided, but bring water and warm layers.

First class is free for neighborhood residents with ID.

Please arrive scent-free; the room is small and we breathe deeply.

Monthly memberships pause anytime for travel or injury.

Private sessions available on weekend mornings by booking.

Our teachers train yearly with senior Iyengar instructors.

Meridian Yoga — 88 Grand Street, Brooklyn
